replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes the pressure of complex proofs or exams triggers anxiety. My low agreeableness means I don't seek help easily, and my high neuroticism amplifies stress. However, I manage it through structured routines and focusing on what I can control.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I used AI for quick explanations of difficult concepts, which helped bridge gaps in my understanding. It felt efficient but impersonal. While it saved time, I still prefer human mentors for deep conceptual discussions and emotional support during challenging periods.
